editions.summary: A first-ever Trump–Xi–Putin summit is planned for next week, Iran claims a strike on a US radar in Bahrain, and Russia and Ukraine agree a prisoner swap.
editions.lead: White House says Trump, Xi and Putin plan first three-way summit

editions.summary: Tankers burn in Hormuz as Trump threatens Iran, Nvidia's founder quits, and Netanyahu's rival gets the first shot at governing Israel.
editions.lead: Tankers burn in Hormuz as Trump threatens new strikes on Iran
